faq_heading: White Rock Square: your questions answered

faq.q: When was White Rock Square built?
faq.a: White Rock Square at 1480 Foster Street (White Rock Square I) and 1442 Foster Street (White Rock Square II) was built 1977–1978 and 1986, per the MLS® strata building record.

faq.q: How big is White Rock Square?
faq.a: White Rock Square is 4 to 7 storeys with About 100 in two buildings.

faq.q: What amenities does White Rock Square have?
faq.a: A fitness room, rooftop garden, sauna, in-suite laundry and underground parking.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Building facts from the City of White Rock info sheets and the MLS® strata building records, read November 14, 2026. Listing box waits on a fixed MyRealPage search.

White Rock Square is two concrete buildings on Foster Street with about 100 homes: White Rock Square I at 1480 Foster (built 1977–1978) and White Rock Square II at 1442 Foster (built 1986). The strata record describes them as adult-oriented, with no pets.
